title: Character pages keep your alts private
content:
Profiles and leaderboards

  • New character pages. Clicking a character name on a battle, the PvP stats page, a guild roster, the frag leaderboard or top gainers now opens that character's own page, with level, race, class, frags, K/D, PvP history and forum activity.
  • Your character list now stays private everywhere. In October we made your Characters tab private, but other parts of the site could still reveal which account a character belonged to. Character links no longer lead to account profiles, the frag leaderboard no longer shows account names, and those lookups have been removed.
  • Your posts are unchanged. Forum posts and battle comments still show your account and the character you chose to post as.
